say:2:1510413002:0.text: So, after a month of back-breaking research and magical analysis way over your head, I wandered all through the city-state next door... which, by the way, is on the verge of collapse...

say:3:1510413003:0.text: My brilliant conclusion is that the locusts' power isn't just in the swarm... It's soaked into the land and air around Halia as well.

say:4:1510413004:0.text: Famine, drought, the gnawing void in every belly... It all points to the same thing.
